title: 第23章 破境 上第24章 破境 中
slug: 修仙开局一部手机修为全靠买
content_zh:
两个月。
苏清欢说出这个期限的时候，刘叙白面上没什么波澜，心里却已经把这两个月拆成了无数个日夜，每一日都在脑子里的日程表上标好了该做的事。他从不浪费时间去焦虑，因为焦虑不会让炼气三层变成四层，也不会让小蝉自己从寒潭谷走到流云峰来。
从苏清欢院子里回来的当晚，他坐在客房的床沿上，没有点灯，在黑暗中把接下来两个月的计划从头到尾理了一遍。第一，突破。他现在炼气三层，距离四层只剩一层窗户纸，但这一层窗户纸恰恰是炼气期最难过的一道坎——炼气三层到四层，是从炼气初期进入炼气中期的分水岭，跨过去灵力质量和经脉强度都会提升一个档次，跨不过去就只能在低阶修士的圈子里打转。第二，剑诀。《悟道剑诀》基础三式他已经熟练，但剑意残片给了他新的启发，需要在实战中融会贯通。第三，小蝉。苏清欢说她来想办法，但他不能把所有希望都寄托在苏清欢一个人身上。如果能在不引人注意的前提下找到接触小蝉的机会，他必须抓住。
第四，也是最重要的——墟市。修为突破之后，墟市的解锁范围会进一步扩大，筑基期的货架会对他开放更多物品。他需要更多的灵石，来换取那些能在关键时刻保命的东西。
刘叙白把计划在脑子里过完，便不再多想，盘腿入定，照常运转灵力。
天亮之后，他开始了到画梅宗以来最枯燥也最充实的一段日子。
每日卯时起床，先练一个时辰的基础剑招。破云、断水、缠风三式反复打磨，每一式都从最慢的速度开始练，慢到剑锋划过空气的轨迹都能用肉眼追踪。这不是在练招，是在练意——那枚剑意石留下的碎片感悟告诉他，真正的剑招不在速度，在于剑锋每一寸移动中对力量的控制。慢练是为了让肌肉记住每一道轨迹，让灵力在经脉中运转的每一个节点都和剑锋的移动完美同步。
辰时去藏经阁，一待就是一整个上午。流云峰藏经阁一层的阅览室他几乎翻遍了，从剑修心得到功法理论，从宗门历史到诸天格局，每一块玉简都不放过。他上辈子是程序员，最擅长的就是在海量信息中筛选出有用的部分，建立起系统的知识框架。半个月下来，他对画梅宗的宗门制度、权力结构、以及剑修体系有了一个清晰的认知地图。最重要的是，他在一本泛黄的旧手札里找到了一句话——“剑修破境，首重悟性，次重实战。悟从观中来，亦从战中来。闭门造车者，十年不出；出则一剑，可抵十年。”
出则一剑，可抵十年。刘叙白把这句话抄在了纸上，压在床头。
午时去医舍看陈砚。陈砚的夹板拆了之后恢复得很快，左臂的活动范围一天比一天大。画梅宗的大夫给他开了一副外敷的药膏和一套简单的复健动作，他每天照着做，龇牙咧嘴疼得满头汗，但从不偷懒。刘叙白每次去都能看到阿宁也在，帮忙换药、端水、送饭，对这个粗手笨脚的外来散修无微不至。她坐在床边，把药膏一点点仔细地抹在陈砚正在愈合的伤臂上，眼睫微垂，专注地好像这是世上最要紧的事。
陈砚一开始还有些不好意思，后来也就习惯了，甚至会主动跟阿宁聊些有的没的——青石镇的旧事、画梅宗的见闻、哪道菜好吃、哪种草药最苦。刘叙白看在眼里，没有说破，只是在某一天离开医舍的时候，顺口说了一句“阿宁这姑娘人不错”。陈砚的耳朵尖瞬间红了，抓起枕头作势要砸他，但嘴角的弧度怎么都压不下去。
未时到申时，是刘叙白一天中最安静的时段。他会回到客院，把上午在藏经阁学到的理论用纸笔整理出来，归纳出对自己修行有实际帮助的部分。然后打坐运转灵力，将积累的感悟一点一点地内化到经脉和丹田之中。这个习惯是他上辈子写代码时养成的——设计文档写清楚了，代码就不会跑偏。修行也是一样，心法想明白了，灵力就不会走岔。
酉时到苏清欢的院子里吃晚饭。这成了两个人之间心照不宣的日常。苏清欢的厨艺确实如她自己所说，比剑术排名还高。她会根据刘叙白当天的修炼强度调整菜式——练剑最苦的那几天，菜里会多放些灵兽肉；在藏经阁泡得久的几天，汤里就会多放些明目的灵植。她从不说什么体贴的话，但每一盘菜都摆在桌上最显眼的位置，每一碗饭都盛得刚刚好。
刘叙白偶尔会跟她聊起在藏经阁看到的趣闻，或者陈砚的恢复进度，或者某道菜的火候。苏清欢大多数时候只是安静地听着，偶尔点头，偶尔简短地应一句。两个人吃饭的画面和之前在青石镇的那个破院子里没什么本质区别，只是桌上多了几盘菜，身后多了一棵开满花的梅树。
两个月的时间就在这种枯燥而充实的节奏里一天一天地滑过去。刘叙白能在静坐中清晰感知到丹田里的灵力光团在一点点变大变亮，从最初的拳头大小扩展到了两个拳头那么大。经脉中的灵力流转也越来越顺畅，之前强行突破时留下的一些细微损伤也在持续的温养中彻底愈合了。但他也能感觉到，炼气四层的那道壁垒依然顽固地横亘在那里，他的灵力还差了最后一把火。
这天傍晚，刘叙白照常去苏清欢的院子吃饭。推开院门的时候，他发现苏清欢没有像往常一样在灶房里忙碌，而是坐在梅树下的石凳上，膝头摊着一本泛黄的旧册子。她的手指在册子上缓缓划过，眉微微蹙着，似乎在看什么让她不太愉快的内容。
“看什么？”刘叙白在她对面坐下。
苏清欢没有抬头，只是把册子往前翻了几页，指着其中一行字让他自己看。那是画梅宗内务堂的一则调令记录，日期是一个多月前，内容很简短——“兹调寒潭谷伙房杂役小蝉至北线矿脉驻地伙房，即日起程，不得延误。”落款处盖着寒潭谷的印章，签章人是韩知渊。
刘叙白的眉头皱了起来。小蝉被调走了，就在苏清欢递交重查申请之后不到十天。韩知渊亲自签章，把最后一名关键证人从两脉交界处的公共伙房直接调到了千里之外的北线矿脉驻地。寒潭谷这是在系统性清理所有可能被接触到的证人，手法干净利落，时间掐得极准。
“你师尊那边能干预吗？”他问。

“矿脉驻地是前线。战时调令属于军务，流云峰无权驳回。”苏清欢合上册子，语气平静，但手指在册子封面上按得有些用力，“韩知渊这一手玩得很漂亮。他把小蝉调走，明面上的理由是北线伙房人手不足，属于正常的人事调动。我就算知道他是为了封口，也没有任何证据去质疑。”
“还有不到一个月就开审了。证人全部被隔离在寒潭谷的掌控范围内，这场重审从一开始就被人架空了。”

content_en:
Two months.
When Su Qinghuan mentioned the deadline, Liu Xubai showed no emotion on his face, but in his heart he had divided these two months into countless days and nights, and marked what he should do on the schedule in his mind every day. He never wastes time worrying, because anxiety will not turn the third level of Qi Refining into the fourth level, nor will it allow Xiao Chan to walk from Hantan Valley to Liuyun Peak on his own.
The night he came back from Su Qinghuan's yard, he sat on the edge of the bed in the guest room, without lighting a lamp, and sorted out his plan for the next two months from beginning to end in the dark. First, breakthrough. He is currently on the third level of Qi refining, and there is only one layer of window paper left before the fourth level. However, this layer of window paper is precisely the most difficult hurdle in the Qi refining period - the third to fourth levels of Qi refining are the watershed from the early stage of Qi refining to the middle stage of Qi refining. After crossing it, the quality of spiritual power and the strength of the meridians will increase by a level. If you cannot cross it, you can only wander in the circle of low-level monks. Second, sword tactics. He was already proficient in the three basic moves of "The Sword Art of Enlightenment", but the fragments of the sword's intention gave him new inspiration, which he needed to master in actual combat. Third, little cicada. Su Qinghuan said that she would come up with a solution, but he could not place all his hopes on Su Qinghuan alone. If he could find an opportunity to contact Xiao Chan without attracting attention, he must seize it.
The fourth and most important thing is the market. After a breakthrough in cultivation, the unlocking range of the market will be further expanded, and more items will be available to him on the shelves in the foundation building period. He needs more spirit stones in exchange for things that can save his life at critical moments.
After Liu Xubai went through the plan in his mind, he stopped thinking about it, crossed his legs and fell into meditation, and continued to use his spiritual power as usual.
After dawn, he began the most boring and fulfilling period since he arrived at Huameizong.
Get up at 9 o'clock every day and practice basic sword moves for an hour. The three moves of breaking the cloud, breaking the water, and entangling the wind were polished repeatedly. Each move was practiced at the slowest speed, so slow that the trajectory of the sword blade through the air could be traced with the naked eye. This is not practicing moves, but practicing mind - the fragments left behind by the Sword Intention Stone told him that the real sword moves are not about speed, but about the control of power in every inch of the sword's movement. Slow training is to allow the muscles to remember every trajectory, so that every node where the spiritual power circulates in the meridians is perfectly synchronized with the movement of the sword edge.
I went to the Buddhist Scripture Pavilion at Chenshi and stayed there all morning. He rummaged through almost all of the reading room on the first floor of Liuyunfeng's Sutra Pavilion. From sword cultivation to cultivation theory, from sect history to the pattern of the heavens, he didn't miss every jade slip. He was a programmer in his previous life, and what he was best at was sifting out useful parts from massive amounts of information and establishing a systematic knowledge framework. After half a month, he had a clear cognitive map of Hua Mei Sect's sect system, power structure, and sword cultivation system. The most important thing is that he found a sentence in an old yellowed handbook - "To break through the realm of swordsmanship, the first priority is understanding, and the second priority is actual combat. Enlightenment comes from observation and from fighting. Those who work behind closed doors will not come out in ten years; if they go out, one sword can be worth ten years."
A single sword can last ten years. Liu Xubai copied this sentence on paper and pressed it on the bedside.
At noon, I went to the doctor's office to see Chen Yan. Chen Yan recovered quickly after the splint was removed, and the range of movement of his left arm is getting wider day by day. The doctor at Hua Mei Zong prescribed him a pair of topical ointments and a set of simple rehabilitation exercises. He followed them every day, grinning in pain and sweating all over his head, but he never slacked off. Every time Liu Xubai went there, he would see Aning there, helping to change dressings, carry water, and deliver meals, taking great care of this clumsy foreign casual cultivator. She sat on the edge of the bed and carefully applied the ointment little by little on Chen Yan's healing arm. Her eyelashes were slightly lowered, as if this was the most important thing in the world.
Chen Yan was a little embarrassed at first, but later he got used to it, and would even take the initiative to chat with Aning about various things - old things in Qingshi Town, experiences of the Painted Plum Sect, which dishes are delicious, and which herbs are the most bitter. LiuXu Bai saw it and didn't say anything. He just said casually when leaving the hospital one day, "A Ning is a nice girl." The tips of Chen Yan's ears instantly turned red. He grabbed a pillow and tried to hit him, but the curve of his mouth could not be suppressed.
When it comes to Shenshi, it is the quietest time of Liu Xubai's day. He would return to the Guest House and sort out the theories he learned in the Sutra Pavilion in the morning with pen and paper, summarizing the parts that would be of practical help to his practice. Then meditate and circulate your spiritual power, internalizing the accumulated insights into your meridians and Dantian bit by bit. This habit was developed when he was writing code in his previous life - if the design document is clearly written, the code will not go astray. The same is true for spiritual practice. If you understand your mind, your spiritual power will not go astray.
Went to Su Qinghuan's yard for dinner at Youshi. This became a tacit and daily routine between the two people. Su Qinghuan's cooking skills are indeed as she said, ranking higher than her swordsmanship. She would adjust the dishes according to Liu Xubai's training intensity that day - on the days when sword training was the hardest, more spirit animal meat would be added to the dishes; on days when the soup was soaked in the Sutra Pavilion for a long time, more eyesight-enhancing spiritual plants would be added to the soup. She never said anything considerate, but every plate was placed in the most conspicuous place on the table, and every bowl of rice was served just right.
Liu Xubai would occasionally chat with her about the interesting things he saw in the Sutra Pavilion, or Chen Yan's recovery progress, or the heat of a certain dish. Su Qinghuan just listened quietly most of the time, occasionally nodding, and occasionally responding briefly. The scene of the two people eating was no different from the old courtyard in Qingshi Town. It was just that there were a few more dishes on the table and a plum tree in full bloom behind them.
Two months passed day by day in this boring and fulfilling rhythm. While sitting quietly, Liu Xubai could clearly feel that the spiritual light group in his Dantian was getting bigger and brighter little by little, expanding from the initial size of a fist to the size of two fists. The flow of spiritual energy in the meridians is becoming smoother and smoother, and some minor injuries left during the previous forced breakthrough have been completely healed with continued warming. But he could also feel that the barrier on the fourth level of Qi Refining was still stubbornly standing there, and his spiritual power was still short of the last spark.
That evening, Liu Xubai went to Su Qinghuan's yard for dinner as usual. When he opened the courtyard door, he found that Su Qinghuan was not busy in the kitchen as usual, but was sitting on a stone bench under the plum tree, with an old yellowed book spread out on her knees. She ran her fingers slowly across the book, frowning slightly, as if she was reading something that made her unhappy.
"What are you looking at?" Liu Xubai sat down opposite her.
Su Qinghuan didn't look up, just turned the book forward a few pages and pointed to a line of text for him to read. It was a transfer order record from the Huamei Sect's Internal Affairs Hall. It was dated more than a month ago and the content was very brief - "Hereby transfers Xiaochan, the handyman of the Hantan Valley kitchen, to the kitchen of the northern mine lode station. He will set off today without delay." The signature is stamped with Hantan Valley's seal, and the signer is Han Zhiyuan.
Liu Xubai frowned. Xiaochan was transferred, less than ten days after Su Qinghuan submitted an application for reexamination. Han Zhiyuan personally signed and transferred the last key witness from the public kitchen at the junction of the two veins to the northern mine station thousands of miles away. Hantan Valley is systematically clearing out all witnesses who may be exposed, with clean and neat techniques and extremely precise timing.
"Can your master intervene?" he asked.
"The mine station is the front line. Wartime transfer orders are military affairs and Liu Yunfeng has no right to reject them." Su Qinghuan closed the booklet and spoke calmly, but pressed her fingers a little harder on the cover of the booklet. "Han Zhiyuan played a very good job. He transferred Xiaochan away. The apparent reason for transferring Xiaochan was that the northern line kitchen was short of manpower, which was a normal personnel transfer. Even if I knew he was trying to keep his mouth shut, I don't have any evidence to question it."
"The trial starts in less than a month. All the witnessesIsolated within the control of Hantan Valley, this retrial was ignored from the beginning. "
